name: io.github.kamiazya/whiteboard
description: Collaborative whiteboard MCP server. Lets AI agents (Claude Code / Codex) and humans co-author diagrams on a shared canvas: create and organise documents (wb_workspace_edit), edit nodes, edges and lines in one batch (wb_canvas_edit), save and restore version checkpoints (wb_version_save, wb_version_restore), and read them back as OKF Markdown, JSON Canvas or rendered SVG (wb_document_get, wb_scene_render). The hosted web app reaches the local daemon through the whiteboard browser extension; the daemon serves no page of its own.
